newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi meets Confindustria on Italy mini-budget.
newsitem.headline: Prodi meets Confindustria on Italy mini-budget.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi met leaders of the business federation Confindustria on Tuesday to discuss the government's mini-budget due to be presented by the end of the month.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, Labour Minister Tiziano Treu, Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco and Regional Affairs Minister Franco Bassanini attended the meeting with Giorgio Fossa, Carlo Callieri and Innocenzo Cipolletta.
Prodi is due to meet union leaders on Wednesday afternoon after a meeting of the centre-left Coalition.
The prime minister said on Tuesday that the mini-budget, expected to include up to 16 trillion lire of deficit-cutting measures, would be presented before Easter.
Political sources expect it to be approved by the cabinet on Thursday or Friday.
